suites.name: Suite 1: Multi-Tenant Isolation & Cross-Tenant Defense
suites.description: Proves Organization A and Organization B isolation. Verifies cross-tenant execution blocking with HTTP 403, parameter tampering rejection, and cryptographic token verification.

suites.name: Suite 2: Authentication, Sessions & RBAC Roles
suites.description: Validates bcrypt password hashing, JWT signing, session expiration, RBAC permissions across Owner, Admin, Manager, Member, and live registration endpoint.

suites.name: Suite 3: Dexie to Centralized Database Migration
suites.description: Validates non-destructive migration engine with dry-run preflight, schema validation across all 10 pipeline entities, and rejection of malformed rows.

suites.name: Suite 4: Distributed Multi-Tenant Pipeline Locking
suites.description: Verifies database-backed distributed locking, multi-tenant lock isolation (same project name across different tenants), and atomic release.
